checks: Matched source 66cd3b069de31436 §2 (4)–(6). Concavity and nonnegative endpoint values place two triangles beneath f of total area at least f(t)/2. Thus the limits are finite and the original endpoints are no larger than the corresponding limits. The continuous representative is still concave and has the same integral.

The right derivative is decreasing and right-continuous on compact interior subintervals, and its Stieltjes measure is positive. Integrating the derivative and subtracting the endpoint chord gives the displayed Green kernel. Recomputed both endpoint derivatives of that kernel, which give monotonicity under expansion.

The limit of the nonnegative kernels is min(t,p)−tp, so monotone convergence is valid even for infinite total curvature. Normalized tents each have integral one and the Green kernel has precisely the p(1−p)/2 factor. Tonelli therefore gives the finite probability weights and the endpoint weights from the affine chord.
